placement: native block_ring_hash_disk_id(original_request_id, block_index, num_ssu), 256 virtual nodes per SSU, same mapping reused by all 8 layers
baseline: native Path0 per-IO FIFO, batch=1, 32 NPUs, 40 GiB/s per SSU, 50 GiB/s per NPU
diagnostic_control: Only pending Path0 IO ordering changes; ascending request per-layer read bytes, FIFO ties, current IO nonpreemptive. This is not once.
input_scope: Constructed underload exploration. Separated repeated profiles, separated unique profiles and all-NPU mixed decks are separately identified. 20/24K compute times extrapolate original 32/48K data. Other interpolated profiles are labeled in each manifest.
statistics: Warm window [2,4) seconds for formal validations; [0.2,0.8) for screening. Nominal bandwidth demand is current admitted request layer bytes on each SSU divided by its own layer compute time. TTFT is admission-relative.
